svg.title: The SED loop
svg.desc: Policies are retrieved into the agent prompt, the frozen agent acts, an external judge scores the trajectory, and harmful episodes are synthesised into new policies used in later episodes.

g.text: Memory is read only during the episode
(7) Updated policy memory used in the next episode
